name: car-image
description: Studio-quality, transparent-background vehicle images for any project. Render any make, model and year in 6 camera views and 15 colors, or mint signed URLs a browser can load without a key.

interface.shortDescription: Transparent-background car images for any project
interface.longDescription: Drop a real vehicle into whatever you are building. Ask for any make, model and year from 1990 to 2027 and get a studio-quality render on a transparent background, in six camera views and fifteen colors. For web pages and emails, mint signed URLs that load without exposing your API key. One credit per image, $1 buys 1,000, and every account starts with 100 free.
defaultPrompt: Add a red 2024 Porsche 911 side view to the hero section.
Build a comparison page with front-3/4 renders of the 2023 Toyota RAV4, Honda CR-V and Mazda CX-5.
How many credits do I have left, and what does a batch of 40 images cost?
